implemented.CPU_boost_request: No request is invented before the first setter. FastLoad1 and Normal0 only update the process logical request. macOS retains CPU/GPU clock management; no overclock, achieved performance, GPU throttling, operation/performance-mode change, APM profile-bank change or notification event is claimed or fabricated
implemented.resume_notification_preference: Enabling/disabling records only the SDK requested bool. No Resume16 message, focus signal, suspended-tick signal, GPU-error signal, logical suspend/resume transition or clock change is fabricated; other notification preferences remain independent
